title: A text statistics tool
request:
Add an MCP tool named text_stats that takes text (string) and answers
{"words": n, "characters": n, "sentences": n, "longestWord": string}. Words are
runs of letters, digits and apostrophes; sentences end at ".", "!" or "?";
characters counts every character of the input. Put the logic in lib/stats.ts as
an exported function textStats(text: string) returning that object, and write
tests for it.
